nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network

nphi.title: SINCEP-Africa – Institutional networks and capacity for epidemiological preparedness in Africa
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire; Ghana Health Service; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; PANDORA platform (France); Fundação Manhiça; Ifakara Health Institute; Makerere University; Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Universidad de Navarra; CTI Africa

nphi.title: ACT-PREP – Advancing clinical trials and epidemic preparedness research capacity in Africa

nphi.title: EpiScientia Network – Data science and epidemiology capacity in African national public health institutes

nphi.title: ANTENNA – Training hubs for statisticians and epidemiologists in Eastern, Central and Western Africa
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Pública (INASA) Guinea-Bissau; Senegal Ministry of Health and Social Action; Hôpital Général de Douala; CRID Cameroon; University of Buea; RARS; UCAD; Joint Clinical Research Centre; Instituto Piaget; Universidade Nova de Lisboa; LSHTM; Universidade de Cabo Verde

nphi.title: Oxford PSI – Institut Pasteur de Dakar three-year partnership
nphi.with: Pandemic Sciences Institute, University of Oxford
nphi.summary: MoU for joint vaccine and rapid-diagnostic development and training in vaccinology, clinical trials and biomanufacturing.

nphi.with: Technical University of Denmark (DTU, SeqAfrica coordinator); Fleming Fund (UK); AMR surveillance sentinel sites
nphi.summary: Institut Pasteur de Dakar trained sentinel-site staff in nanopore whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics for antimicrobial resistance surveillance, as part of the DTU-coordinated SeqAfrica project funded by the UK Fleming Fund.

nphi.title: UKHSA–Institut Pasteur de Dakar strategic partnership (MoU)
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur de Dakar
nphi.summary: A 2024 MoU on co-developing vaccines and diagnostics for emerging threats, early detection and surveillance in Senegal and West Africa, and epidemic laboratory capacity. Rapid tests for measles and onchocerciasis are among the outputs.

nphi.title: Team Europe Initiative: Strengthening Public Health Institutes in Africa (TEI PHI)

nphi.with: Africa CDC; IANPHI; WHO; African NPHIs
nphi.summary: Launched March 2024 by the European Commission, 12 EU Member States and Africa CDC to strengthen African NPHIs' institutional capacity, regional collaboration and workforce, including linking European and African public health institutes;…

nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: EBO-PEP – Ebola Zaire post-exposure prophylaxis preparedness and efficacy evaluation
nphi.with: INSERM (coordinator); Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire (ANSS) Guinea; ALIMA; PANDEMIC platform; ISGlobal; Université de Bordeaux; PAC-CI; Université Gamal Abdel Nasser de Conakry; UCAD; MSF Belgium

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Fellowship Scheme Senegal – Phase 2
nphi.with: National Laboratory of Public Health (Senegal); Albert Royer Hospital microbiology laboratory
nphi.summary: Fondation Mérieux hosts the Fleming Fund phase 2 fellowship in Senegal, pairing mentors and fellows from the National Laboratory of Public Health and hospital labs to strengthen AMR surveillance.

nphi.title: GHIT Fund – Institut Pasteur de Dakar MoU on neglected disease products
nphi.with: Global Health Innovative Technology (GHIT) Fund
nphi.summary: MoU to speed development of therapeutics, vaccines and diagnostics for neglected diseases and promote technology transfer from Japanese companies and academia.

nphi.title: CDC Senegal country office

nphi.summary: CDC began working in Senegal in 2001 (office 2015), supporting the Ministry of Health on surveillance, the national PHEOC, laboratories, FETP (since 2015), HIV/TB, malaria and immunization.

nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: SPHERE-Africa – Strengthening Public Health Education in Research & Epidemiology in Africa

nphi.with: US CDC and CDC country offices; national public health laboratories and institutes; veterinary laboratories
nphi.summary: Two regional Strengthening Laboratory Management Toward Accreditation training-of-trainers workshops (Monrovia and Saly, April–May 2026) trained 40 laboratory professionals from 15 countries to build a regional quality and accreditation…

nphi.title: MADIBA vaccine manufacturing facility – EIB/Team Europe financing

nphi.title: NCDs-WAfrica – evaluating healthy food environment policies in Francophone West Africa

nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: CARES – Casamance research programme on HIV resistance and sexual health

nphi.with: WHO Regulation and Safety (Switzerland); InphA (Germany); national regulatory authorities and drug quality control labs of partner countries

nphi.with: Expertise France; Fondation Mérieux; INSERM
nphi.summary: EU-funded project with Institut Pasteur and French partners that deployed a mobile laboratory and trained staff to detect risk-group-4 viruses in Ebola-affected West African countries.
